name: Product sourcing price table: Taobao vs AliExpress vs TikTok Shop

parameters.content:
## Product sourcing prices by currency

Compare one row per platform, with lowest and median listing prices grouped by explicit currency. Taobao/Tmall stays in CNY; no exchange conversion is performed.

AliExpress uses your keyword; optional TikTok Shop uses pasted category or product links. Top five listings are ranked by reported sales, not by prices in different currencies. Missing prices are shown as unavailable.

### Setup
Create an Apify Header Auth credential (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) on the HTTP Request node, then edit **Set your product idea**.

### Cost
Review each linked Actor’s current pricing and limits. Platform/start fees may apply even without delivered results. Listing prices exclude landed costs.

## 1. Your product idea
English keyword for AliExpress, Chinese or English for Taobao, optional TikTok Shop links. The legacy cnyPerUsd input is retained for compatibility but ignored; no FX conversion occurs.

## 2. Search each platform
One Apify call per selected platform. Error-marked rows are excluded from price statistics. Check Actor pricing for applicable start and result fees.

## 3. Compare
One row per platform with priceGroups by native currency. Legacy USD fields cover confirmed USD only. Unknown currencies are displayed but excluded from comparable price statistics.
